svg.text: Noise in a thousand small steps forward; learn to remove one step at a time backward
sqrt(alpha-bar): how much signal is left
x_t = sqrt(alpha-bar_t) . x_0 + sqrt(1 - alpha-bar_t) . epsilon - any step reachable in ONE draw, which is why training is cheap.
Training target: predict the epsilon that was added. A plain regression with a fixed target - no game, no discriminator.
Price: sampling runs the network once per step. A thousand forward passes against a GAN's one.
Fast samplers cut it to twenty or fifty, which is the difference between a research result and a product.
